stalls.summaryZh: 炸得外酥內嫩的臭豆腐，是海線夜市的熟面孔。
stalls.summaryEn: Crisp-outside, tender-inside stinky tofu, a familiar name across the coastal markets.

stalls.summaryZh: 台中海線知名炸雞攤，多種部位任選，排隊常見。
stalls.summaryEn: A well-known coastal Taichung fried chicken stall with many cuts to choose from; lines are common.

sources.title: 好好玩FUNIT 台中夜市整理

stalls.summaryZh: 鐵板現煎牛豬肉，份量足，價位比一般攤高但用料好。
stalls.summaryEn: Steak and pork seared to order on a hot plate; pricier than most stalls but generous and well sourced.

stalls.summaryZh: 梅粉胡椒口味的酥炸三角骨，邊走邊吃很涮嘴。
stalls.summaryEn: Fried chicken cartilage with plum-pepper seasoning, an addictive walking snack.

sources.title: 食尚玩家 台中夜市懶人包（2025-11）

stalls.summaryZh: 現涮溫體牛肉湯配滷肉飯，適合當正餐。
stalls.summaryEn: Fresh beef soup poured to order with braised pork rice, a proper meal.

stalls.summaryZh: 煎得厚實香酥的蚵仔煎，攤前經常排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: Thick, crisp-edged oyster omelet with a regular queue.

stalls.summaryZh: 外皮酥脆的章魚燒，起司與海苔肉鬆口味受歡迎，放涼也不軟爛。
stalls.summaryEn: Crispy-shelled takoyaki; cheese and seaweed-floss flavors are favorites and stay crisp when cool.

stalls.summaryZh: 先滷後烤的可樂雞，部位選擇多，攤位整潔是加分點。
stalls.summaryEn: Braised-then-grilled cola chicken in many cuts, from a notably clean stall.

stalls.summaryZh: 現烤胡椒餅外酥內多汁，也賣起司薯餅。
stalls.summaryEn: Freshly baked pepper buns with juicy filling, plus cheese hash browns.

stalls.zh: 泰厚 CHILL 泰式奶茶
stalls.summaryZh: 現沖泰奶搭熱壓香蕉煎餅，是夜市裡的南洋風點心。
stalls.summaryEn: Fresh Thai milk tea paired with pressed banana roti for a Southeast Asian touch.

stalls.summaryZh: 蒜味濃郁的滷米血與黑豆乾，可請老闆加辣。
stalls.summaryEn: Strongly garlicky braised rice-blood cake and black tofu; ask for extra chili.

stalls.summaryZh: Q黏的糯米玉米炭火烤香，可選單色或雙色。
stalls.summaryEn: Chewy waxy corn grilled over charcoal, in single or two-color cobs.

stalls.summaryZh: 鐵板牛排加麵不加價，內用玉米濃湯與紅茶可續，CP值高。
stalls.summaryEn: Sizzling steak with free extra noodles and refillable corn soup and tea for dine-in; good value.

stalls.summaryZh: 炸物品項多，雞腿丁與脆薯是人氣選項。
stalls.summaryEn: Wide fried-food menu; thigh bites and big fries are crowd picks.

stalls.summaryZh: 一口大小的煎餃和湯包，適合邊走邊吃。
stalls.summaryEn: Bite-size potstickers and soup dumplings that are easy to eat on the go.

stalls.summaryZh: 被食尚玩家列為五權夜市代表攤之一，主打川味酸菜魚。
stalls.summaryEn: Listed by Supertaste as one of the market's signature stalls, serving Sichuan-style pickled-cabbage fish.

sources.title: 台中27個夜市全蒐集（食尚玩家）
